turns.content: A positron of total energy E_beam strikes an electron at rest in e+e- -> X. In natural units, derive the initial invariant s in terms of E_beam and the electron mass m_e.
If the final state is a single particle X produced at threshold, relate its mass M_X to the invariant you just derived.
Evaluate s and M_X for E_beam=9.6 x 10^6 GeV and m_e=0.000511 GeV.
State the resulting mass and explain how the threshold condition fixes it.
Check the dimensions and the accuracy of neglecting the term of order m_e^2 at this beam energy.
Report the mass of X and the invariant-mass relation used to obtain it.
